recipe.visualDefinition: A full-body studio portrait captured through an extreme wide-angle fisheye lens, creating a circular image within a black square frame. The subject is centered in a curved, minimalist room with sky-blue walls and a dusty-pink floor, featuring a gloved hand reaching into the frame from the bottom left.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered within a spherical distortion field
High-contrast interaction between the black foreground hand and the pastel background
Complementary relationship between the sky-blue walls and the magenta/pink clothing and floor
Vertical elongation of the subject's legs due to lens curvature
coreInvariants: Circular frame within a black square
Minimalist set with distinct color blocking

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centrally located, appearing small relative to the total frame but dominant due to the central vanishing point.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's magenta shirt provides the primary color anchor, while the black gloved hand in the foreground acts as a compositional entry point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the foreground hand, follows the curve of the lens upward to the subject's face, and then circulates around the spherical perimeter.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy black negative space occupies the four corners outside the circular image.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Sky blue (walls) and dusty pink (floor) create a soft, surreal environment.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Magenta (shirt) and black (gloved hand) provide sharp visual breaks from the pastels.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cream/white (trousers) and gold (buttons) add highlights and texture.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-key pastels with low-to-medium saturation, contrasted by a single high-saturation magenta point.

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed within the black negative space

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single weight sans-serif to maintain minimalist aesthetic.

candidateDirections.reason: Neutrality and clarity at small sizes.
Modern geometric structure fits the contemporary aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a person in high-waisted white trousers and a magenta shirt, shot through a fisheye lens. The room should have curved sky-blue walls and a dusty-pink floor. Include a black gloved hand reaching into the bottom left corner. Frame the entire image as a circle inside a black square.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a small white sans-serif logo or text block in the bottom right corner, strictly within the black negative space area.

verificationChecks: Is the image perfectly circular within a black square?
Does the fisheye distortion noticeably curve the walls and floor?
Is the foreground hand rendered in solid black silhouette or dark texture?
Is the color palette restricted to blue, pink, magenta, and white?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Check for extreme barrel distortion on vertical lines
Ensure the black corners are pure black (#000000)
Confirm the subject is centered in the 'globe'
Verify the magenta shirt is the most saturated element
recipe.reuseFormula: Fisheye Studio Portrait + [Color A] Walls + [Color B] Floor + [High Contrast Foreground Object] + Circular Masking
